about: Module and dependency map of the Rust MnemoCode (docs/design/architect/ARCHITECTURE.md sections 2 and 3), read by the code-rules gate (cargo xtask code-rules). layers: a library module may use the foundation and the modules listed for it ('*': every module); a module of mnemocode-cards or mnemocode-cli uses only the modules before it in 'order'; every listed edge of an existing library module is used. deps: each crate's direct dependencies per target, its devDependencies for its tests, and refusedInTree for every artifact. unsafe: 'forbid' in the crate root, or 'deny' with allow(unsafe_code) only in the files and folders of allowedIn (paths relative to the crate, a folder ending in /). ioModules: the only CLI files and folders whose top may expect clippy's disallowed std methods and types, besides test modules and integration test files. ownRefusalCodes: each code that the port writes and TS's catalogs do not hold, with why.

mnemocode-wasm.dependencyNotes: wasm-bindgen and getrandom on every target, so that the native clippy and tests build the binding too and its entries that draw randomness run in the tests, from the system's source; getrandom =0.4.3 with wasm_js on wasm32 for the Random adapter, and from the sskr increment =0.3.4 with wasm_js renamed getrandom03, only to give bc-rand's tree its browser backend; mnemocode-cards only with feature browser-cards; no js-sys.

sskr.vendored: A workspace member as in TS (sskr-wasm/rust/Cargo.toml:47): fmt, clippy and test cover it with its own [lints] table, exempt from [lints] workspace = true; every file byte-equal to UPSTREAM.json downstreamSourceSha256.

bc-crypto.lockRule: Cargo.lock lists bc-crypto without a registry source: an unmatched [patch.crates-io] only warns, and crates.io bc-crypto with its C libsecp256k1 would come back.

refusedInTree.about: Refused anywhere in cargo metadata's resolve of the executable and of every WASM profile (T4, T10, T17).

ownRefusalCodes.export.pdf-documents.font-not-embedded: the writer of a PDF: TS's pdf-lib has no such refusal
ownRefusalCodes.export.pdf-documents.not-written: a sink of a PDF that refuses a write: TS keeps a PDF in memory
ownRefusalCodes.export.image-export.page-not-drawn: the drawing of a page image: TS's Poppler has its own failures
ownRefusalCodes.cli.protection.private-screen-required: the owner's refusal of a secret result without a private screen (PLAN.md)
ownRefusalCodes.cli.output-paths.outside-ruled-folders: the owner's refusal of a retry outside the ruled folders (PLAN.md)

ownRefusalCodes.failed-save-left-staging-copy: TS writes it outside its catalogs
ownRefusalCodes.failed-save-left-reservation: TS writes it outside its catalogs
